'''Blut''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], who worked for the company [[Culpharm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Blut was employed by Culpharm as a security guard and in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], along with the Sullustan [[Mien]], he was sent to the house of the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Waz-alem Amir]], to collect a specimen sample for Culpharm. The following day, he was present in the [[Culpharm Headquarters Building]], in the city of [[Hedrett]].
